ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job and the growth curve rises cleanly from Crier news on turn 2 to Gundel and Rattenkönig boards; only the top end gets less positional.
ratings_why.distinct: News that halves per step along a tied graph is a real new board puzzle, though it sits close to Hedgerow's touching-run growth.

verdict_why: v3 closed the Thirty-Two compounding loop and the Knot reading problems; what is left is heat and taste, not a fix.

points.text: We, the Rattenkönig removes halving, so position stops mattering at the very top. Halving once per two steps instead would keep the late game a placement puzzle while still paying off big.
Taster Wendelin next to an eating Ooze feeds the board, which grows the next Eat: a slow loop paid for by losing units. Fine as a high roll; worth one sim with Ilse repeating it.
Economy is thin for a climber: one conditional gold piece and a gold-negative Committee. A Tier 3 or 4 piece that pays when news reaches an end would help mid-game tempo.
Wake-Keeper is a generic death trigger. Letting its Gossip start on the dead Rat's slot would tie it to the slot-stays-in-the-Knot rule.
Speaker with Mill-Chimney and Rattenkönig gives every unit the biggest unit's stats in a fight; with goldens it is about four times that. In-fight only, so it is a spike, not a runaway.

standouts.why: Mill-Chimney Voice makes where you stand the main decision every turn, the tribe's best mid-game card.
Speaker Brotkrume turns any tribe's big unit into a board-wide payoff, a clear tall route at Tier 6.
Town-Hall Crier shows the mechanic visibly on turn 2 and gives a strong early curve.

weakest.why: Wake-Keeper is a stock death trigger with little tie to the Knot's shape.
Supper Committee costs gold per trigger and needs a touching sale, so it is rarely the right buy.
Ratskeller Landlady is passive 1 gold that fires almost always; no decision.

flags.note: Gundel board with Rattenkönig adds about 100-130 permanent stats a turn; linear, not compounding, but the hottest line in the tribe.
Ooze Eat next to Wendelin, repeated by Ilse, is a large single gain that feeds the next Eat.
Golden Speaker plus Chimney plus golden Rattenkönig gives every unit about four times the biggest unit's stats in a fight.
